name: meta-skills
description: Meta-domain skills — skills about skills. One so far: routing-decomposer (decompose, design, and grade a skill's frontmatter description on the INSTRUCTION x ROUTING axes — does it say the right thing AND fire on the right cases, not over- or under-trigger — scored separately, with a mechanized precision/recall/F1 routing-eval over a labeled corpus plus a description linter). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
